chars.WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her late twenties, long dark wavy hair (no headscarf), wearing a mustard-yellow knit cardigan over a white t-shirt and dark green trousers
chars.HUSBAND: a young Moroccan man in his early thirties, short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a burgundy hoodie and grey jeans
chars.BABY: a newborn baby girl wrapped in a pale pink blanket

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the bedroom doorway, head-to-waist: WIFE sits on the edge of the bed in a modest Moroccan apartment in Safi, holding BABY in her arms, tears running down her face, wiping her eyes with one hand, upset and lost in thought. Warm evening lamp light. Face clearly visible, centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a small Moroccan kitchen, WIFE turns angrily toward HUSBAND, arms raised in frustration, shouting, while HUSBAND stands back surprised with open palms. Both faces visible, centred in the frame. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan living room with a traditional sedari sofa, HUSBAND sits next to WIFE and gently talks to her, hand on her shoulder, patient; WIFE looks away from him with crossed arms, cold and distant. Both faces visible, centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: At night, HUSBAND sits alone on the living room sofa in the dark, face lit by the blue glow of his phone screen, scrolling and reading with a worried frown. Head-to-waist, face centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text, the phone screen shows only light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND stands in a dim apartment hallway, leaning on the wall, watching suspiciously through a half-open door; in the room beyond, WIFE sits on the bed with her back half turned, staring out of the window. HUSBAND's face visible in the foreground, centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night in a modest Moroccan bedroom, both fully dressed: WIFE lies on her side turned away from HUSBAND, eyes open, tired and distant; HUSBAND sits up against the headboard looking at her back, puzzled and hurt. Soft moonlight, faces visible, subjects centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Memory scene with a soft warm hazy glow: on the living room sofa, WIFE smiles playfully and holds her phone out toward HUSBAND as if showing him something, relaxed and teasing; HUSBAND looks at her confused. Both faces visible, centred. The phone screen shows only light. 2D animated illustration style, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND stands alone on a small apartment balcony at night in Safi, rooftops and a few lit windows behind him, hands gripping the railing, staring into the distance, deep in suspicious thought, jaw tight. Head-to-waist, face visible, centred. 2D animated illustration style, no text.
